recognize_zh: 周邊血中出現核偏位、胞質深嗜鹼的漿細胞樣細胞，骨髓抹片則被成片漿細胞取代（核偏位、核旁淡染區，偶見雙核），指向漿細胞腫瘤，並需評估是否有循環漿細胞增加。
features: Circulating plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm in the peripheral blood (panel A)
Occasional short red cell stacks suggestive of mild rouleaux in the blood film
Marrow aspirate particle and trails replaced by sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm (panel B)
Perinuclear hof (Golgi zone) and occasional binucleate or immature plasma cells with more open chromatin at higher power (panel C)
Marked reduction of normal hematopoietic elements, with only scattered neutrophils
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, with short rouleaux in the background. The bone marrow aspirate is hypercellular and composed predominantly of sheets of plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, including occasional binucleate and immature forms; normal trilineage hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with circulating plasma cells; quantitation of blood plasma cells (plasma cell leukemia threshold ≥5%), clonality studies and serum/urine protein studies are required for classification.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, polytypic and rarely exceed 10-20% of marrow cells, without sheets or immature binucleate forms.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Plasmablasts are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli and very high Ki-67, unlike the predominantly mature plasma cells seen here.
